UNIVERSITY OF KASHMIR
NAAC ACCREDITED GRADE A++
UNIVERSITY CAMPUS, HAZRATBAL, SRINAGAR 190006,KASHMIR.
NOTICE
It is notified for the information of all the candidates who have submitted their online application form in
response to Advertisement Notice No. 17 of 2026, dated August 06, 2026, for the posts of Assistant Professor
in the following subjects/departments that the provisional list of applicants reflecting the Provisional claimed
API Score and deficiencies is given in Annexure 1, II and III to this Notice:
 Centre of Central Asian Studies (Archaeology)
 Centre of Central Asian Studies (Kashmiri)
 Urdu
If the candidate has any query regarding the discrepancy shown against his/her status, he/she may approach in
person to the office of the Recruitment Section of the University of Kashmir with documentary proof within 07
days from the date of issuance of this notice i.e., up to and including 10-11-2026
No claim after 10-11-2026 for clearance of deficiencies shall be entertained.
The candidature of all the candidates shall remain purely provisional and shall be subject to fulfillment of
eligibility conditions prescribed in the Advertisement Notice.
Besides, the deficiencies/observations in respect of other subjects will follow shortly. The concerned applicants
are directed to check Jobs/Recruitment link of the University website regularly with regard to the same.
Note: -
1. Please note that all the Notifications shall be made available only on the Official website of the University
and notices shall neither be published in print media, nor shall any candidate be informed individually.
2. Notices uploaded on the official website of the University shall be deemed to have been served to the
candidates.
By order,
Sd/-
Deputy Registrar
Recruitment
